confirmed.facts: Observed helper process token is elior; immediate original parent is preexisting System32/msiexec.exe with LocalSystem token, not initiating client process. Production has not been run through this admission.

Engine is checked live and later its handle is closed. The actually waited process is the original authenticated guardian and its exit code must be zero. A baseline shared MSI service process must not be required to exit.
Independent x86 per-user fixture reports prefix01 and formal uninstall/absence cleanup; keep exact product matcher unchanged. This does not prove product MSI admission/maintenance.

proposedModel.helperUser: Session.resources.sid remains actual current helper process TOKEN_USER, require_user unchanged. Begin, broker, Guardian, advisory notices and named-pipe impersonated peer all remain exactly this user and pinned helper image SHA. LocalSystem must never be accepted as a helper merely because its parent is trusted.
proposedModel.engineCapability: Separate private EngineCapability from user identity: exact opened original process handle, PID+creation FILETIME, image constrained to OS WindowsDirectory/System32 or SysWOW64 msiexec.exe and pinned nonreparse OS image, parent-before-child creation, still live; classify token as CurrentUser or exact well-known LocalSystem only. Reject arbitrary other SID, LocalService and NetworkService. Never overwrite resources.sid with engine SID and never select KnownFolder/Run from engine identity.
proposedModel.binding: Begin pins its own engine; broker authenticates original Begin parent instance (same helper SHA/user) and independently derives/pins the same engine process instance; original BEGIN acknowledgment only to that Begin PID+creation. Guardian remains original authenticated pipe peer instance, matching helper user/image and exact pinned engine parent instance. Original Guardian handle is duplicated into the original owner ledger before any decision. Notices remain advisory.
proposedModel.transaction: Packet transaction ID is correlation only. Real Guardian code must successfully call MsiJoinTransaction with engine-supplied argv then MsiEndTransaction; original ENDED must match stored ID/decision and original guardian identity, then original Guardian exit0 and independently reconciled effects, checked closes and original Pending/gate release. No fake effects receipt, caller flag or PID packet becomes authority.
proposedModel.limits: An exact long-lived SYSTEM msiexec parent is not a unique MSI session. Even this composite protocol does not independently prove an external EXE Begin knows the later transaction ID; current scope relies on the controlled unchanged candidate wiring and the pinned helper code plus real MSI Join validation. Do not claim arbitrary external packages/TRANSFORMS are authenticated. If a stronger Begin-to-hInstall identity guarantee is demanded, current Type2 API lacks that handle and this two-SID change alone cannot provide it.
proposedModel.retention: Keep original 120-second deadline, 12 connections, fixed handle/owner bounds, sticky failure and unknown-owner retention. Engine death before settlement is negative, but engine remaining live after guardian return is normal. Do not kill/wait for service process, initiate client process or unrelated engine processes.
